page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-32-highlssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance within the z4d server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 252.0 GB of system memory. This allocation results in a resource density of approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not feature any graphics processing units, and local storage is specified as none.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio positions this server class for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density support workloads with large working sets without the overhead of GPU hardware. This profile is suitable for memory-intensive applications, database caching layers, enterprise applications, and large-scale data processing tasks that do not require local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
